description.text: An enhanced expansion pack released on 5 April 2019, led by Garchomp & Giratina-GX, whose GX attack puts one of the opponent's Pokémon straight into the discard pile. Raichu & Alolan Raichu-GX is its other TAG TEAM, with Heatran-GX, which can do 300 damage with six Fire Energy, and Mawile-GX, whose Ability brings Basic Pokémon from the opponent's hand onto their Bench. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 54, ending with four Trainer Rare cards marked TR, followed by full-art Super Rare cards, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Tag Switch, Reset Stamp and Karate Belt. In English many of its cards came out in Unified Minds in August 2019.
